crossRefs.note: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold…
The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children…

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

translations.web: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
translations.bsb: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
translations.kjv: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
translations.asv: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
